note: Recast from Rocha & Cancello (2009), original in English; the original records the alate as Unknown, so only the soldier is listed; no measurement data.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier has type-2 mandibles and a head capsule shorter than in O. gibberorum, O. heberi, O. insignis, O. orthognathus and O. uncimandibularis; it differs from the other species in that the short hairs are dense only on the ventral surface of the head capsule and there are no setae.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Sides of the head slightly convergent anteriorly in dorsal view. Dorsal tubercle slightly prominent in lateral view, situated behind the lateral projection. Mandibles type 2, with a tooth-like process on the proximal half. Head capsule surface sparsely setose, short hairs denser ventrally, minute hairs present on the surface. Postmentum with fairly dense setae and short hairs. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum with setae; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum with setae; abdominal tergites and sternites densely setose.
